_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); chemical and refining signals

pit_profile.why: Risk factor (FY2014 10-K): Our business operations are subject to the cyclical and volatile nature of the supply-demand balance in the chemical and refining industries.; no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a chemicals and refining company on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution': none names chemicals or refining, and no 10-K names cloud, offshore delivery, or e-commerce), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

classification.quality_note: Risk factor (FY2014 10-K): Our business operations are subject to the cyclical and volatile nature of the supply-demand balance in the chemical and refining industries.; no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a chemicals and refining company on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution': none names chemicals or refining, and no 10-K names cloud, offshore delivery, or e-commerce), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule). cyclical (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 0.87x; +50% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.81; conservative 2yr -19%.

BEAR.desc: EPS +0.0%/yr (worst year FY11-FY14, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS -5.6%/yr (Q4 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 4.3-yr ex-FY10 median

BULL.desc: EPS +22.8%/yr (FY11-FY14 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +27.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY11-FY14, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LYB (retrospective, 2015-04-17) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 0.87x (34.1% downside to Bear $63 / +39.0% upside to Bull $133) | Adj composite 1.25 vs market 3.06: gap -1.81 [OVERVALUED] | +49% above the EPP floor $64 (8x FY15E $8.00) | Conservative 2-yr case: -18.7% total (-9.3%/yr) | At 12.0x FY15E the 15% hurdle price $126 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; O&P–Americas +18.6% and Intermediates & Derivatives -35.2% operating income in Q4 2014, forward revenues -7.6% (no FY15 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2014 revenues as reported); no theme in the registry is live for a chemicals and refining company on this date; none has dated evidence.
